blocks.prompt: 3. In a nonlinear LC circuit, the equilibrium charge \(q\) on the capacitor satisfies \(q^{3} - 4q + 2 = 0\). Find the equilibrium values of charge stored on the capacitor lying in the interval \([0, 1]\) using Regula-Falsi method accurate to three decimal places.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh ek cubic equation hai, aur humein sirf woh root chahiye jo diye gaye interval [0, 1] mein ho.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval. Find kya karna hai? Teen decimal places tak charge q.
Rule kaunsa? Regula-Falsi formula, aur teen places ke liye tolerance 0.0005.
Plan: [0, 1] par sign change check, phir 5 decimal places rakh kar formula chalana jab tak |f(c)| 0.0005 se kam na ho jaye.
Aakhir mein sign test se teesre decimal ki tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(q^{3} - 4q + 2 = 0\), interval \([0, 1]\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 1]\) mein equilibrium charge \(q\), teen decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi, \(c = \frac{af(b) - bf(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\). Teen decimal places ke liye 8.3.1 ka rule \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) hai, is liye working mein 5 places rakhenge.

Function, continuity, sign change
\[f(q) = q^{3} - 4q + 2\]
\[f(0) = 2 > 0, \quad f(1) = -1 < 0\]
Kyun: f polynomial hai, is liye [0, 1] par continuous hai, aur kinaron par signs ulte hain. Location of Root Theorem ke mutabiq [0, 1] mein root zaroor hai.

Jab tak a = 0 hai, ek shortcut
\[c = \dfrac{0 \cdot f(b) - b \cdot 2}{f(b) - 2} = \dfrac{2b}{2 - f(b)}\]
Kyun: har iteration mein \(f(c)\) negative aata hai, is liye \(a = 0\) aur \(f(a) = 2\) kabhi nahin badalte. Formula mein inhein rakh dein to yeh chhota sa formula ban jata hai, aur hisaab tez ho jata hai.

Iteration 3
\[c = \dfrac{1.125}{2.07202} = 0.54295\]
\[f(0.54295) = -0.01174\]
Kyun: \(b = 0.54295\); \(|f(c)|\) abhi 0.0005 se bara hai, is liye aage chalte hain.

Tasdeeq
\[f(0.5385) = 0.00216 > 0\]
\[f(0.5395) = -0.00097 < 0\]
Root \(]0.5385, 0.5395[\) mein hai, is liye 0.539 par round hota hai. Baqi do real roots (taqreeban 1.675 aur \(-2.214\)) \([0, 1]\) se bahar hain, is liye sawal ke mutabiq jawab sirf ek hai.
Kyun: 0.539 ke dono taraf aadhe faasle par sign test teeno decimal places ko pakka karta hai.
